info.title: Recoup API - Research
info.description: API documentation for the Recoup platform - an AI agent platform for the music industry

get.description: Returns chats for the authenticated account. Personal Bearer tokens see only the caller's chats; org keys see chats across the org's member accounts; admin keys see all chats. Each row carries the chat id and the session id needed to build the chat URL.

parameters.name: artist_account_id
parameters.description: Optional. Filter chats to only include those whose owning session's `artistId` matches the supplied artist account id. Combine with `account_id` to scope by both owner and artist.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Filter to a specific account. Only applicable when the authenticated account has access to multiple accounts via organization membership.

400.description: Bad request - invalid query parameters

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - account_id is not a member of the organization or account tried to filter by an account_id they don't have access to

post.description: Create a new chat room. Optionally associate it with an artist and/or provide a client-generated chat ID. Pass accountId to create a chat on behalf of a specific account the API key has access to.

400.description: Bad request - failed to create chat

403.description: Forbidden - API key does not have access to the specified accountId

patch.description: Update a chat room's topic (display name). The chatId is required; the topic field will be updated. Topic must be between 3 and 50 characters.

400.description: Bad request - invalid parameters or validation error

403.description: Forbidden - API key does not have access to this chat

delete.description: Delete a chat room by ID. This operation also removes related room records (memory emails, memories) before deleting the room itself.

400.description: Bad request - invalid parameters or validation error

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - API key does not have access to this chat

404.description: Not found - chat room does not exist

post.description:
Start an asynchronous, headless chat-generation run on the durable agent workflow — the same engine as interactive [`POST /api/chat`](/api-reference/chat/workflow).

**Related endpoints**
- [`POST /api/chat`](/api-reference/chat/workflow) — use that for **interactive, streaming** turns on an existing chat; use this for **headless/programmatic** runs (no browser or pre-provisioned session needed).
- [`GET /api/chat/runs/{runId}`](/api-reference/chat/runs-status) — poll to learn **whether** the run finished (and if it succeeded).
- [`GET /api/chat/{chatId}/stream`](/api-reference/chat/workflow-stream) — **watch the output live** by passing the returned `chatId`.

202.description: Run accepted. A durable workflow run was started; `runId` identifies it. `chatId` / `sessionId` identify the persisted output — read the result via [`GET /api/chat/{chatId}/stream`](/api-reference/chat/workflow-stream) (resume the stream) or the chat's persisted messages. Poll [`GET /api/chat/runs/{runId}`](/api-reference/chat/runs-status) for status.

Location.description: Relative URL of the run-status resource for the started run.

400.description: Bad request - missing required parameters

post.description: Stop the response currently being generated for a chat, freeing it to accept a new message. Idempotent — returns `stopped: false` when nothing is in progress. The chat must belong to the authenticated account.

parameters.name: chatId
parameters.description: UUID of the chat to stop.

400.description: chatId is not a valid UUID

403.description: The chat belongs to a different account

get.description:
Reconnects to an in-progress chat response — the resume counterpart to [`POST /api/chat`](/api-reference/chat/workflow), which never resumes. Returns the live Server-Sent Events stream when a response is still being generated, or `204 No Content` when there is nothing to resume. The chat must belong to the authenticated account.

**Related endpoints**
- [`POST /api/chat`](/api-reference/chat/workflow) — the interactive turn whose stream this resumes.
- [`POST /api/chat/runs`](/api-reference/chat/runs) — start a **headless** run, then pass the returned `chatId` here to **watch its output live**.
- [`GET /api/chat/runs/{runId}`](/api-reference/chat/runs-status) — check **whether** that run finished (status, not content).

parameters.name: chatId
parameters.description: UUID of the chat to resume.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Act on a chat belonging to another account. Only honoured for a key that is authorised for that account — an organization key may pass a member account's id; a personal key passing anyone else's is rejected with `403 Access denied to specified account_id`. Omit it to act as the authenticated account.

parameters.name: startIndex
parameters.description:
Zero-based index of the first stream chunk to return, so a client that was already receiving this response resumes where it left off instead of replaying the whole turn.

Pass the number of chunks already received. Omit it to receive the response from the beginning — the right choice for a fresh reader such as a page load, or a client watching a headless [`POST /api/chat/runs`](/api-reference/chat/runs) run for the first time.

A long turn's stream can end before the run does; reconnecting with `startIndex` is how a client keeps rendering without duplicating or skipping chunks.

200.description: Server-Sent Events stream of UI message parts for the in-progress response, compatible with the Vercel AI SDK. The `x-workflow-run-id` response header carries the run ID for this response, and `x-workflow-stream-tail-index` carries the index of the last chunk known when this read was opened — a base for computing absolute positions, not a record of where the response ended.

x-workflow-run-id.description: Durable workflow run ID of the resumed run.

x-workflow-stream-tail-index.description: Zero-based index of the last chunk known to the stream **at the moment this read was opened**. Because headers are sent before the body, a read that stays open past that point will deliver chunks beyond it — so this is a base for computing absolute positions, not a record of where the response ended. A client resuming precisely should count the chunks it receives on top of this value. Omitted if the runtime cannot report it.

schema.description: Server-Sent Events stream containing UI message parts

204.description: No active stream to resume for this chat.

400.description: `startIndex` was provided but is not a non-negative integer.

401.description: Missing or invalid credentials.

403.description: The authenticated account does not own the referenced chat.

post.description:
Streams an agent loop running as a durable [Vercel Workflow](https://vercel.com/docs/workflow) against the session's sandbox. The agent uses sandbox-only tools (`bash`, `read`, `write`, `grep`, `glob`, `todo`, `task`, `ask_user_question`, `skill`, `fetch`) — no MCP or Composio. Requires a sandbox provisioned via [`POST /api/sandbox`](/api-reference/sandbox/create).

**Related endpoints**
- [`POST /api/chat/runs`](/api-reference/chat/runs) — the **headless** counterpart: it provisions its own session + sandbox and runs without a streaming client. Use that for tasks/cron/programmatic runs; use this for **interactive, streaming** turns on an existing chat.
- [`GET /api/chat/{chatId}/stream`](/api-reference/chat/workflow-stream) — reconnect to an in-progress response.
- [`GET /api/chat/runs/{runId}`](/api-reference/chat/runs-status) — check **whether** a headless run finished (status, not content).

200.description: Server-Sent Events stream of UI message parts compatible with the Vercel AI SDK `createUIMessageStreamResponse`. The `x-workflow-run-id` response header carries the durable workflow run ID for resume/stop operations.

x-workflow-run-id.description: Durable workflow run ID. Persist alongside the chat so a later `GET /api/chat/{chatId}/stream` request can resume this run after a disconnect.

schema.description: Server-Sent Events stream containing UI message parts

403.description: The API key's account does not own the referenced `sessionId` or `chatId`.

409.description: A response is already streaming for this chat. Reconnect to it via `GET /api/chat/{chatId}/stream` instead of POSTing again.

post.description: List an artist's live shows. Returns one row per event with venue, city, country, ticket link, and lineup.

200.description: Events for the artist. An artist with no matching events returns an empty `events` array, not an error.

400.description: Validation error

get.description: Get the current Spotify play count for one recording by ISRC, served from the Apify-backed measurement store. A fresh capture is returned as-is; a stale or missing one triggers a refresh of the recording's album through the Spotify play-count actor before responding.

parameters.name: isrc
parameters.description: Track ISRC. The recording must have a Spotify album mapping in the measurement store (created by a `current` measurement job or a catalog snapshot).

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Only `spotify` is supported; defaults to `spotify`.

200.description: The recording's current Spotify play count from the measurement store.

400.description: Validation error — `isrc` missing, or `source` is not `spotify`.

401.description: Authentication failed — invalid or missing API key.

404.description: Nothing stored for this ISRC and no Spotify album mapping to refresh from — create a `current` measurement job for it first.

402.description: Insufficient research credits — the body includes a static `billingUrl`. No Stripe object is created.

get.description: Time-series of a track's measured counts.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Provider-neutral track id — ISRC or Spotify track id.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform to read. Currently `spotify`.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Metric to read.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start date (ISO) for the series.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive end date (ISO) for the series.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Series granularity. `daily` returns the per-day cumulative series.

parameters.name: aggregate
parameters.description: Return a derived aggregate instead of the raw series. `run_rate` returns the trailing-window annualized run-rate (a projection of the series).

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Trailing window for `aggregate=run_rate` (e.g. `365d`).

200.description: The measurement series (or the requested aggregate).

400.description: Validation error — bad identifier or query param.

401.description: Authentication failed — invalid or missing API key.

404.description: No measurements for this track yet — create a `current` measurement job to capture it.

get.description: Latest measured count per track on an album, from the measurement store. `{id}` is a Spotify album id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Spotify album id.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform to read. Currently `spotify`.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Metric to read.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Return the latest capture per track (the only supported mode today).

200.description: Latest per-track measured counts for the album.

401.description: Authentication failed — invalid or missing API key.

404.description: No capture exists for this album yet — create a `current` measurement-job.

post.description: One async ingest resource. `source:"current"` captures present counts via the snapshot pipeline. Provide exactly one of `catalog_id` / `album_ids` / `isrcs` in `scope`. The returned `id` is a snapshot id you can pass to [Create catalog](/api-reference/songs/catalogs-create) to materialize the measured tracks into an account-owned catalog.

400.description: Validation error — provide a `source` and exactly one of `scope.catalog_id`, `scope.album_ids`, `scope.isrcs`.

401.description: Authentication failed — invalid or missing API key.

get.description:
Status of an asynchronous run started via [`POST /api/chat/runs`](/api-reference/chat/runs). Returns a point-in-time snapshot (**is it done?**) — not the generated content.

**Related endpoints**
- [`POST /api/chat/runs`](/api-reference/chat/runs) — starts the run this reports on.
- [`GET /api/chat/{chatId}/stream`](/api-reference/chat/workflow-stream) — read the **content**: poll *this* to know **whether** a run finished; use the stream to **watch the output** as it's produced.
- [`POST /api/chat`](/api-reference/chat/workflow) — the interactive, streaming counterpart to a headless run.

parameters.name: runId
parameters.description: The durable workflow run id returned by [POST /api/chat/runs](/api-reference/chat/runs).

404.description: No run found for the given runId

success.description: Always true when the request was processed.

stopped.description: True when an in-progress response was cancelled; false when nothing was running.

error.description: Error message describing what went wrong

message.description: Error message describing what went wrong

ChatGenerateRequest.description: Request body for chat generation. Exactly one of 'prompt' or 'messages' must be provided.

prompt.description: Single text prompt for the assistant. Required if 'messages' is not provided.

messages.description: Array of UIMessage objects for context. Required if 'prompt' is not provided.

artistId.description: The unique identifier of the artist (optional)

model.description: The AI model to use for text generation (optional)

trigger_run_id.description: Optional. When the run is kicked off by a Trigger.dev scheduled task, the Trigger run id (`run_...`). The started workflow's `{ sessionId, chatId, workflowRunId }` are written to that Trigger run's metadata so the scheduled run can be traced to the chat that did the work.

room_id.description: UUID of the parent chat room

content.description: Structured message payload stored for the memory

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp of the memory update

sessionId.description: Session that owns this chat. Combine with `id` to build the chat URL: `/sessions/{sessionId}/chats/{id}`.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last update.

artistId.description: Artist account id this chat's session was created in the context of, or `null` when no artist was associated. Inherited from `sessions.artist_id` on the owning session.

error.description: Error message describing what went wrong

missing_fields.description: Present on validation failures (400): the path of the field that failed. Empty for a malformed path parameter.

ChatWorkflowRequest.description: Request body for the sandbox-driven, Workflow-backed chat endpoint. Requires an existing session, chat, and provisioned sandbox. The Bearer key from the `Authorization` header is forwarded into the sandbox for skill-based callbacks to the Recoup API — no separate access-token field needed.

messages.description: Conversation history as an array of `UIMessage` objects, matching the [Vercel AI SDK](https://sdk.vercel.ai/) `UIMessage` shape. The last entry is typically the new user turn — the agent loop reads the entire array and persists the latest user message before the workflow starts.

chatId.description: UUID of an existing chat under `sessionId`. The chat's `active_stream_id` column is used for compare-and-set race control across concurrent requests.

sessionId.description: UUID of the session that owns both the chat and the sandbox. The session must have a non-null `sandbox_state` — call [POST /api/sandbox](/api-reference/sandbox/create) first if not.

context.description: Optional per-prompt context overrides forwarded into the agent loop.

contextLimit.description: Upper bound on the number of tokens / messages of conversation history the agent should consider for this prompt. Overrides the model's default for this call only.

chatId.description: Array of chat IDs to compact

prompt.description: Optional prompt to control what information gets preserved in the compacted summary

chatId.description: The ID of the chat that was compacted

compacted.description: The compacted summary text of the chat

error.description: Error message describing what went wrong.

targetChatId.description: Target chat room UUID to receive the copied messages.

clearExisting.description: When true, existing messages in the target chat are deleted before copy.

copied_count.description: Number of messages copied from source to target.

cleared_existing.description: Whether existing target messages were deleted before copy.

message.description: Error message describing what went wrong

artistId.description: UUID of the artist account the chat is associated with

chatId.description: UUID for the new chat (client-generated). If not provided, one will be generated automatically.

accountId.description: UUID of the account to create the chat for. Only applicable when the authenticated account has access to multiple accounts via organization membership. If not provided, the chat is created for the API key's own account.

topic.description: Topic name for the new chat room (e.g., 'Pulse Feb 2'). To edit the topic of an existing room, use [PATCH /api/chats](/api-reference/chat/update).

error.description: Error message describing what went wrong.

ResearchDeepRequest.description: Request body for deep research. Performs comprehensive multi-source analysis.

query.description: The research question — be specific and detailed for best results.

content.description: The full research report as markdown.

citations.description: Source URLs cited in the report.

input.description: What to research (e.g., "Drake rapper from Dallas Texas").

schema.description: JSON schema defining the fields to extract. Must include `"type": "object"` at the top level.

output.description: Structured data matching the provided schema.

citations.description: Source citations supporting the enriched output.

field.description: Which output field this citation supports.

objective.description: What information to focus on (optional, max 3000 chars).

full_content.description: Return full page content instead of focused excerpts.

errors.description: URLs that failed to extract. Only present when one or more URLs could not be processed.

query.description: Natural language search for people (e.g., "A&R reps at Atlantic Records").

id.description: Unique result identifier from the search provider.

publishedDate.description: Date the profile or page was published.

author.description: Author of the page, if available.

query.description: The search query — what you want to find on the web.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

country.description: ISO country code for regional results (e.g., 'US', 'GB').

ResearchWebResponse.description: Web search results with titles, URLs, and content snippets.

snippet.description: Content snippet from the search result.

formatted.description: Results formatted as markdown for easy reading.

UIMessage.description: A message in the chat conversation. See https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/reference/ai-sdk-core/ui-message for details.

role.description: The role of the message sender

content.description: The text content of the message

message.description: Error message describing what went wrong

chatId.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the chat room to update

topic.description: The new display name for the chat room. Must be between 3 and 50 characters.

ResearchEventsRequest.description: Request body for artist event lookup.

artist_id.description: Recoup artist id. Events are resolved through the live-events profile connected to this artist, so the lookup is exact and cannot drift to a same-named performer. Returns 404 if no live-events profile is connected.

events.description: Matching events, ascending by date. Empty when the artist has none.

region.description: State or region where the source provides one. US venues carry a state code such as "TN"; most non-US venues return an empty string, as in the example below.

country.description: Country name. Pair with `city` before filtering by market, since city names such as London and Paris are not unique across countries.

ticket_url.description: Ticket link where one is published.

sold_out.description: Whether the source marks the event sold out.

lineup.description: Billed artists, the queried artist first. More than one entry means a shared bill.

ResearchErrorResponse.description: Error response returned by all research endpoints for validation failures (400) and authentication errors (401).

error.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong.

ResearchTrackStatsResponse.description: Current Spotify play count for one recording from the measurement store.

ResearchTrackStat.description: Per-source current statistics for a single track.

data.description: Per-source counters for this track. `streams_total` is the platform-displayed play count from the measurement store, not a royalty-bearing stream count.

data_source.description: Provenance of the numbers: `apify_spotify_playcount` (platform-displayed count from the measurement store) or `granted_analytics` (customer-granted data).

captured_at.description: When this entry's values were captured into the measurement store.

ResearchInsufficientCreditsResponse.description: Returned (402) when the account lacks research credits. Nothing is charged and no Stripe object is created. Credits must be bought explicitly via [`POST /api/credits/sessions`](/api-reference/credits/sessions-create).

billingUrl.description: Static link to the Recoup app, where a human can save a card and buy credits. It is a constant, not a freshly minted Stripe Checkout Session, so a credit-gated endpoint that keeps returning 402 creates nothing. To buy credits programmatically, call [`POST /api/credits/sessions`](/api-reference/credits/sessions-create).

ResearchMeasurementsResponse.description: A track's measured series, or — when `aggregate` is set — the derived projection.

ResearchMeasurementJobResponse.description: `id` is the snapshot id to poll.

ChatGenerateAcceptedResponse.description: Confirmation that an asynchronous chat-generation run has been started on the durable agent workflow.

runId.description: Durable workflow run id for the started generation. Same identifier surfaced as the `x-workflow-run-id` header on interactive [POST /api/chat](/api-reference/chat/workflow).

chatId.description: Chat the run writes its assistant messages to. Use with [`GET /api/chat/{chatId}/stream`](/api-reference/chat/workflow-stream) to resume the stream, or to fetch the persisted messages.

sessionId.description: Session (workspace + sandbox) provisioned for the run.

ChatRunStatusResponse.description: Point-in-time status of an asynchronous chat-generation run.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the run. Read the produced content via the chat (`chatId` from the start response).

createdAt.description: When the workflow run was created.

startedAt.description: When the workflow run started executing; null while queued.

completedAt.description: When the workflow run reached a terminal state; null while queued or running.

durationMs.description: `completedAt - startedAt` in milliseconds; null until the run is terminal.

ResearchDataSourceUnsupported.description: The configured research data source does not support this endpoint or data shape.
